info.title: Izetta: The Last Witch
info.synopsis:
La serie si svolge in un mondo immaginario che somiglia all’Europa prima della Seconda Guerra Mondiale. Scoppia una guerra su vasta scala e ovunque nel mondo si combattono sanguinose battaglie. Eylstadt è una piccola nazione priva di un forte esercito o risorse naturali. Finé, regina di Eylstadt, decide di usare un’arma segreta contro le nazioni più vaste: si tratta di Izetta, una giovane della sua stessa età e l’ultima strega dai capelli rossi ancora in vita.
Izetta usa il suo enorme potere magico per abbattere aerei e far esplodere carri armati. Poiché grazie a lei Eylstadt vince battaglie su battaglie, la gente di tutto il mondo comincia a chiamarla “La Strega Rossa di Eylstadt”. Tuttavia, l’esistenza delle streghe era stata tenuta nascosta per diversi motivi. La magia di Izetta cela molti oscuri segreti. Il suo potere proibito ha aperto la porta della speranza e della distruzione.
Questa è la storia di una regina che vuole salvare il suo Paese e una giovane strega che combatte per la sua migliore amica e la sua gente.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Young princess Finé, the daughter of the Archduke of a small alpine country, travels to the neutral land of Westria to seek help against the Germanian empire that is invading her kingdom. But her plans go awry when she's captured by the Germanians, and transported by air back to their capital of Neu-Berlin. Then a strange light appears at the back of the plane, and a witch begins to awaken...

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Finé and Izetta escape the burning wreckage of the plane on the back of a rifle. But squad of Germanian pilots participating in the invasion of Eylstadt hear the transport's distress call and move to intercept them. Izetta is forced to use her magic to fight them off, breaking the rule her grandmother gave her. When the enemy planes are shot down and driven away, Izetta takes Finé to join the retreating Eylstadt army, where she reminisces about how they met.

Waves of bombers are striking from the skies, and an entire company of tanks is tearing apart the helpless infantry. But when all seems lost, a red-haired witch appears from the skies...

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: With Izetta's victory over the Germanian army fresh in people's minds, the army of the Dukedom decides to make her into a national icon and announce her to the world. She's given the finest white dress they have to offer and a huge ceremony is arranged with journalists from all over the globe. But before she can be used in combat, they need to unravel the secret of her strength, which means she must travel to a hidden location with a girl who doesn't like her very much at all.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Izetta is powerful enough to fight whole armies, but her strength is limited. She can only use her abilities near certain ley lines, and outside them, she's no different than a normal girl. When the Germanian army attacks in a spot far from these ley lines, the duchy is forced into a corner: how can they repel these foes without giving up the secret of Izetta's strength?

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Izetta has been defeated by Sophie, the true White Witch. Sophie is out for revenge against the Dukedom for the crimes their ancestors committed, and she'll gladly work with Germania if they'll help her destroy it. Izetta and the princess barely escape to a hidden fortress in the mountains, but Izetta is so badly injured she can't walk. How can she stop Sophie from destroying her country?

episodes.synopsis: The capital of Landsbruck has fallen, and Izetta and the princess are chased into the mountains. As the imperial forces track them down, Seig makes Izetta an offer: he's willing to give her the other half of Sophie's magic stone. With this powerfulitem she fight toe-to-toe with Germania's witch, but it causes the user tremendous pain, and shortens their lifespan...

info.title: Shuumatsu no Izetta
info.synopsis: Shuumatsu no Izetta (Izetta: The Last Witch) è ambientato in un Europa alternativa nell'anno 1939. La Germania sta soccombendo ormai si più di metà Europa e la sua politica imperialistica sembra inarrestabile. La principessa Finè, erede del piccolo regno di Eylstadt, è disposta a tutto pur di salvare le sorti del proprio paese e decide di chiedere aiuto a Izetta, probabile ultima strega rimasta al mondo, dotata di un potere tale da determinare da sola le sorti del conflitto.
